source: # 背景描述
- 甲状腺疾病已成为高发内分泌疾病，结节与功能异常检出率持续上升，传统诊疗易出现漏诊、误诊与过度干预。开展甲状腺多维度数据分析，可挖掘甲功指标、影像特征与人群特征的关联规律，构建风险预测与良恶性鉴别模型，实现疾病早筛、精准分型与个体化诊疗，同时为流行病学监测、病因探索及公共卫生防控提供数据支撑，对提升诊疗效率、降低医疗成本、改善患者预后具有重要临床与社会价值。
# 数据说明

        df_tmp = pd.read_csv(path, sep=sep, encoding="utf-8")
        if df_tmp.shape[1] > 1:          # 分隔符匹配成功（解析出多列）即返回

# 2.2 全量数据：各特征与 tumor 的相关性系数（Pearson，二值变量即点双列相关）
corr_all = df_ml[feat_cols + [target]].corr()
corr_with_target = corr_all[target].drop(target).sort_values(ascending=False)
print("特征与 tumor 的相关性（降序）:\n", corr_with_target.round(3))

corr_with_target.plot(kind='barh', figsize=(8, 5))
plt.title('各特征与 tumor 的相关性系数')
plt.xlabel('相关系数')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 2.3 切分数据集（stratify 分层抽样，保证训练/测试集阳性率一致）
X = df_ml[feat_cols]
y = df_ml[target]

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y
)
print("训练集:", X_train.shape, "| 测试集:", X_test.shape)
print("训练集阳性率: {:.2%} | 测试集阳性率: {:.2%}".format(y_train.mean(), y_test.mean()))

# 2.4 基于切分后的训练集计算相关性矩阵（13 特征 + tumor）
train_corr = pd.concat([X_train, y_train.rename(target)], axis=1).corr()

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10))
sns.heatmap(train_corr, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='RdBu_r', vmin=-1, vmax=1,
            square=True, cbar_kws={'label': 'Pearson r'})
plt.title('训练集相关性矩阵（含 tumor）')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# 2.5 训练集上「特征 × tumor」相关性（聚焦目标变量）
train_corr[target].drop(target).sort_values(ascending=False).plot(kind='barh', figsize=(8, 5))
plt.title('训练集：各特征与 tumor 的相关性')
plt.xlabel('相关系数')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
# 第三步：训练模型

# 3.1 定义统一评估函数（类别不平衡，重点关注召回率、F1、AUC）
def evaluate_model(name, model, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test):
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    return {
        '模型': name,
        '准确率': accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred),
        '精确率': precision_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0),
        '召回率': recall_score(y_test, y_pred),
        'F1': f1_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0),
        'ROC-AUC': roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob),
        'PR-AUC': average_precision_score(y_test, y_prob),
        '混淆矩阵': confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred),
        '模型对象': model,

# 3.2 训练三个模型（class_weight='balanced' / 样本加权，缓解类别不平衡）
results = []

# 逻辑回归：系数可直接解释为对肿瘤概率的影响方向
lr = LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, class_weight='balanced', random_state=42)
results.append(evaluate_model('逻辑回归', lr, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test))

# 随机森林
rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, class_weight='balanced',
                            random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
results.append(evaluate_model('随机森林', rf, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test))

# 梯度提升（无 class_weight 参数，改用样本加权平衡）
pos_w = (y_train == 0).sum() / max((y_train == 1).sum(), 1)
sample_weight = np.where(y_train == 1, pos_w, 1.0)
gb = GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=42)
gb.fit(X_train, y_train, sample_weight=sample_weight)
y_pred_gb = gb.predict(X_test)

# 4.1 KNN 超参数网格搜索：n_neighbors / weights / metric
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV

# 说明：13 个特征全部是 0/1 二值、量纲一致，KNN 无需标准化；
# 若以后加入连续型特征，请先对 X_train / X_test 做 StandardScaler 再训练 KNN。
param_grid = {
    'n_neighbors': list(range(1, 22, 2)),             # 1, 3, 5, ..., 21
    'weights': ['uniform', 'distance'],               # 等权 / 按距离加权
    'metric': ['manhattan', 'euclidean', 'hamming'],  # hamming 对二值特征更合适
}
grid = GridSearchCV(KNeighborsClassifier(), param_grid, cv=5,
                    scoring='roc_auc', n_jobs=-1, verbose=1, return_train_score=True)
grid.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("最佳参数:", grid.best_params_)
print("5 折交叉验证 ROC-AUC: {:.4f}".format(grid.best_score_))
results.append(evaluate_model('KNN(优化)', grid.best_estimator_, X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test))

# 4.2 KNN 优化过程可视化：不同 n_neighbors 下的交叉验证 ROC-AUC
cv_results = pd.DataFrame(grid.cv_results_)
cv_results['n_neighbors'] = cv_results['param_n_neighbors'].astype(int)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
for w in ['uniform', 'distance']:
    sub = cv_results[cv_results['param_weights'] == w]
    line = sub.groupby('n_neighbors')['mean_test_score'].mean()   # 跨 metric 取平均
    line.plot(ax=ax, marker='o', label=f'weights={w}')
ax.set_xlabel('n_neighbors'); ax.set_ylabel('交叉验证 ROC-AUC')
ax.set_title('KNN 优化：n_neighbors vs 交叉验证 ROC-AUC')
ax.legend(); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
